verdict.rationale: Shortwave is a client layered on Gmail via Gmail's APIs, so a Gmail user's existing mail is synced in. One user reports aliases and signatures were imported, and the AI can 'search your entire email history.' However, community reports say it only works with Google servers, and the free plan doesn't import mail from more than 90 days before signup for search. missing for 10: import from non-Gmail providers or other clients (IMAP/mbox), any evidence of contacts import, full-history import on the free tier, first-party migration documentation.
